GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down last 8 Lengths 800m last 14 Lengths home turn Under Pressure last Hooked Out Middle Of Track 200m to run on well Stewards: jockey advised tongue tie was dislodged # last/ran on hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rider explained that his mount was slow into stride and raced very greenly throughout the early and middle stages. He said, despite being ridden along through the middle stages, the gelding would not respond however, after balancing up in the straight, it worked to the line well over the concluding stages. Rider further added that upon pulling up he became aware his mount had dislodged its tongue tie which may have contributed to it being intractable.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Pushed fwd & shared lead Two Wide early . Back 1 length to 2nd Two Wide midrace & back 1 length @ 700m. Pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 550m & struggling to hold ground Two Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground Two Wide in last 200m. # On-pace/weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out at the start and made contact with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 3 lengths. 2nd turn 4 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok went to front. led turn. battled away # Every Chance
Jumped Ok trapped Wide early before settling outside leader. 2nd turn hard ridden. battled away # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the tactics adopted, rider advised that he was instructed to attempt to take up a forward position and consequently his mount was able to settle outside the leader. Co-trainer confirmed the instructions and said that they had been consistent with the instructions issued on each occasion, however today the gelding was able to take up a forward position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1/2 length Settled Down well back 3 Wide 8 lengths. well back Wide turn. Held Ground # Never Likely
Jumped Ok eased from barrier 8 lengths. last turn. hooked very Wide in Straight . ran on strongly # good from barrier
Jumped Ok Settled Down 2nd 2 lengths. 3rd turn 3 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the tactics adopted, rider advised that she was instructed only to attempt to make her mount begin as it had been getting back too far in its races. She added after beginning reasonably well today and to avoid being trapped wide, she continued to ride her mount along in the early stages and was able to obtain a position just off the leader. Co-trainer confirmed the instructions and expressed surprise that the gelding raced so prominently.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Cross Over Nose Band off f/t Tongue Tie f/t bad bump start Wide Eased back Settled Down Off Mid-Field 5l Two Wide home turn 5L Battled on # made late ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Was contacted on jumping by another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 length Settled Down long last. eased out of race # pulled up
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rider advised that after beginning awkwardly and losing initial ground his mount travelled for only a short distance and then did not travel at any stage after and as he was concerned with his mount’s welfare and as it continued to lose ground, he did not test it from the 700m. A post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality. Co-trainer was told that a veterinary clearance would be required prior to the gelding also having to barrier trial to the Steward’s satisfaction prior to being permitted to race again. Vet cert rec & since trialled.
